description: This file declares the interface for MQTT-based shell transport in Zephyr OS, including structures, constants, and function prototypes related to MQTT shell communication.

methods.name: shell_backend_mqtt_get_ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the shell MQTT backend instance for testing commands.

methods.name: shell_mqtt_get_devid
methods.description: Defines the device ID used as client ID for MQTT connection; can be overridden.
